title: Territory bands heard in Dallas around 1930: Troy Floyd, Don Albert, Alphonso Trent
summary: He names members of the bands he heard, including Herschel Evans, Stuff Smith, Peanuts Holland, Snub Mosley and Dan Minor.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Let's go back. So let's go back -- now, you were just calling some names. We're talking about Dallas.
And you said, like, Tee Holden.
Right.
He had a pretty good band, didn't he? A territory band, wasn't it?
That's right. That's right.
You were going to look at up. Yeah, it'd be interesting to know who all --
Mac Shan.
Oh, right.
You've heard of J. MacShan.
You know I've heard of J. MacShan.
Well, we can't come on MacShan too early, we've got to make a few steps before that. Well, listen, put it off for a minute, Gus, and we'll just look this up and get it right, what do you say?
(Recording interrupted.)
-- here occasionally, you see. We're talking about when you were in Dallas, and this was, say, like, '29, '30, 1930.
Yeah.
And who you got to hear. Some of these well-known bands.
Yeah, like Troy Floyd.
Who all was in Troy Floyd's band? You said Don Albert.
Yeah, Don Albert and also Herschel Evans was in the band.
Was he? What?
Right.
And his home base was San Antonio.
San Antonio, Texas.
Is he still around?
I haven't saw him in quite a while. Last -- well, Herschel, you know, he's dead.
Yeah, yeah.
But I was in San Antonio with Basie.
Oh, yeah.
That's last time, and we were at his club. He had a club there.
Oh, he had a club there then.
Yeah.

Well, listen, tell me something. We were talking about that. When you were coming up like that, there must have been certain guys that gave you a big thrill. Did Herschel have that big tone at that time? Did he sound like that at that time?
He had his own sound.
Sound, his beautiful sound.
I was just listening to the other day. Every one, --
: Yes.
There wasn't a certain one that I really picked out.
: No.
Nobody but the drummer, really.
: Yeah, right. What drummers did you hear then? Who was the drummer -- any drummers that --
Just any drummer that --
You don't remember, there were no particular drummers, in his band, for instance, Troy Floyd's?
NO.
But what about Alphonso Trent? Who was the drummer in that band?
Oh, --
: Can you remember?
I can't think of his name, but --
Well, listen, we were talking about Alphonso Trent. Was it he that Dan Minor was in the band?
Dan Minor was in the band, too.
: And who else? Hudson?
A.G. Godley, and Henderson George Hudson, and Anderson Lacey, Holland. he was in there. Peanuts Harley.
: Peanuts, uh-huh. Holland.
Yeah, you know Peanuts Harley. He's over in Europe, I think.
Yeah, yeah.
Snub Mosely.
Snub Mosely. And you said Stuff Smith.
Stuff Smith, yeah, he was the front man for Alphonso Trent.
He was the front man?
Yeah.
Is that right? Well, of course, he could play very good violin right then, couldn't he?
That's right.
Yeah, yeah.
And I really didn't meet him until I went to New York.
Isn't that a funny thing? All these musicians you didn't meet until you --
Til I got to New York.
Yeah.
I saw them, but just didn't meet them.
